response.justification: The candidate is a clearly experienced, versatile senior engineer with 15+ years across web, backend, and some systems programming, but the role is fundamentally a hands-on senior C++ position in industrial automation with SDL/IEC 62443 security requirements. His C++ exposure is limited to a brief 7-month stint at National Instruments (2014–2015) and a thesis project, while his core stack is TypeScript/Node.js/DLang for web platforms. There is no evidence of MQTT, industrial protocols, IEC 62443, or secure development lifecycle experience, making the fit too weak despite strong general engineering credentials.
strengths: Extensive senior-level experience with high-performance, low-latency systems (DLang microservices handling millions of requests/sec)
Strong software craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, event-driven architectures, mentoring and workshop leadership
Some systems-level background (C/C++ at National Instruments, embedded/audio work, multi-threaded async I/O)
concerns: Minimal professional C++/STL experience — the core requirement of the role — and none recent (last used ~2015)
No industrial automation, IoT/MQTT, or industrial protocol (Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850) experience
No demonstrated exposure to IEC 62443 or formal Secure Development Lifecycle practices

key_factors.factor: Strong general seniority and high-performance systems experience
